A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
cytomegaloviral infection is not an uncommon problem in pregnancy, and that it can lead to severe sequelae.
cytomegaloviruses are a common infection during pregnancy, but only a small proportion of infected mothers will transmit the infection to the fetus.
